scenes.title: First licks
scenes.subtitle: Short phrases from the scale.
lines: This lesson teaches short, simple phrases from the scale — your first licks.
Play them slowly, and let your fingers find their way.

scenes.heading: Licks
points: Licks bring your playing to life
lines: A lick is a short musical phrase that brings your playing to life.
Focus on the rhythm and repetition as you practice these simple patterns.
Once the notes are clean, add expression by letting the last note ring or using gentle vibrato.
You're doing great — keep it slow and steady, and let your sound shine through.

scenes.title: Lick 1
lines: Let's try Lick 1: a smooth, descending phrase that moves across strings 2, 3 and 4.
Play each note in order, following the lights on the tab and fretboard.

scenes.title: Lick 2
lines: Let's try Lick 2: a simple melody on the top two strings.
Start at string 1, fret 5, then move to fret 8, back to 5, and across to string 2.
